stories.text: NYPA narrowed 21 applicants to 10 developers, including Holtec, TerraPower and X-energy, for the first 1 GW of New York's planned nuclear buildout.
Skanska and Traylor Bros. finished the $1.6B Portal North Bridge, replacing a 116-year-old Hackensack River swing span on the Northeast Corridor.
A permitting overhaul cleared the Senate 62-33, putting a 150-day clock on many environmental lawsuits; the House takes it up next.
An expert panel found Canada short on geodetic ground stations, with thin GNSS coverage in the North and heavy reliance on foreign positioning systems.
Eutelsat's US defense arm will bundle backup positioning and timing with OneWeb satellite links under a Space Force deal worth over $60M.
Japan's DX Antenna built a featherweight four-band GNSS antenna for survey and farm drones that also picks up Michibiki correction signals.
Mining fundraising dropped 28% to about $9.8B last quarter even as companies reported a record number of drill holes, per S&P Global data.
Gold slid to its weakest level in 14 months while producers' all-in sustaining costs jumped 22% year over year, squeezing margins.
Angola's state diamond firm Endiama says it will pay roughly $180M for 10% of De Beers as Anglo American works toward an exit.
